metadata.clean_title: High Protein Indian Bodybuilding Meal - Vegetarian
metadata.description:
Hello Friends. I bring to you, yet another, high protein vegetarian recipe - The good old Sweet Potato Chaat. Sweet Potato Chaat is a famous dish of India. This recipe of mine is the healthier version of it. It is high in protein, moderate in complex carbs, high in fiber, low in fat, loaded with vitamins and mineral making it a complete meal in itself.

INGREDIENTS

1. Sweet Potato (Boiled) - 100 g
2. Black Chana (Boiled) - 100 g
3. Paneer (low fat) - 100 g (Suggested: Make Paneer at home)
4. Onion (chopped) - 1 cup
5. Tomato (chopped) - 1 cup
6. Cucumber (chopped) - 1 cup
7. Curd (low fat) - 50 g (Suggested: Use homemade curd)
8. Salt
9. Pepper
10. Tomato Ketchup - 1 tsp 
11. Lemon juice - 1 lemon

You can use finely chopped fresh coriander leaves to garnish it.

Just mix all the ingredients and your healthy and high protein sweet potato chaat is ready. Enjoy it.

Well, if you enjoyed the recipe, please 

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT

Also, please Subscribe for more healthy recipes - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Thanks for your time.

I wish you good health.
- Fit Tuber

metadata.original_title: High Protein Vegetarian Recipe for Bodybuilding
metadata.clean_title: High Protein Vegetarian Recipe for Bodybuilding
metadata.description:
Vegetarian food is often dissed for having low Protein value. But hang on, here I present to you a Healthy and High Protein Vegetarian Snack Option. This is my High Protein Oats Tikki recipe.
This is so crispy and so tasty that I am currently obsessed with them. Not only it is tasty but also very easy to make. Each Tikki has a whopping 12 grams of protein. Try it out!

Ingredients:

1. One cup (80g) Rolled Oats powdered in a blender.
2. 100g low fat Cottage Cheese (Paneer) ainto small pieces
3. 50g of  Soya Granules soaked for an hour or so.
4. 2 medium sized Onions finely chopped.
5. 2 medium sized Tomatoes for puree.
6. Green Chillies (1-2) chopped.
7. Garlic (4-5 cloves) chopped.
8. Salt and Pepper seasoning.

This recipe can be prepare in an Air Fryer, Oven, Microwave, Non Stick Pan etc.

I hope you found the video helpful.

Thanks for Watching !!!

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT

Subscibe by clicking the below link:

https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Thanks for giving me your valuable time. Much appreciated :)
 
- Fit Tuber

Hello Friends. I bring to you our very own Moong Dal Dosa also known as Pesarattu. This dosa is made from the barter of high protein and fibrous green gram. It is a popular dish in Andhra Pradesh and Rajasthan. It surely deserves a try.

INGREDIENTS

1. Green Moong Dal (soaked overnight)  - 100 g
2. Paneer (low fat)  - 100 g (Suggested: Use homemade paneer)
3. French beans
4. Carrots
5. Capsicum
6. Green peas
7. Onion
8. Tomato
9. Salt
10. Turmeric
11. Chilli Powder

You can use finely chopped fresh coriander leaves to garnish it.

This Moong Dal Dosa is high in protein, moderate in complex carbohydrates, rich in fiber, low in fat and loaded with vitamins and minerals. It is a complete meal. It can be enjoyed in breakfast,lunch or dinner.

Well, if you enjoyed the recipe, please 

LIKE | SHARE | COMMENT

Also, please Subscribe for more healthy recipes - https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCYC6Vcczj8v-Y5OgpEJTFBw

Thanks for your time.

I wish you good health :)
- Fit Tuber
